Done! I've created `src/routes/posts.js` with the `postPath(title)` function. 

**What it does:**
- Imports the `slugify` utility from the existing `src/utils/slugify.js` (the app's canonical URL slug rules)
- Exports `postPath(title)` which returns `/posts/` followed by the URL-safe slugified form of the title
- Matches the exact pattern used by `src/routes/users.js` for consistency

**Example usage:**
```javascript
postPath('My First Blog Post')  // → "/posts/my-first-blog-post"
postPath('Café & Restaurant')   // → "/posts/cafe-and-restaurant"
```
